Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the WebSurfer’s findings and recorded Uzhaikkum Karangal’s release year as 1996 instead of 1976 (the DuckDuckGo snippets for both Wikipedia and IMDb clearly show 1976 with a 23 May 1976 release). This transcription/misreading error led to the incorrect conclusion that The Cemetery Club (1993) was released first.
